name: VTU CBCS 2022 Scheme (NEP)
description: VTU NEP-aligned CBCS 2022 Scheme — 40 marks CIE + 60 marks SEE, 5 units, practical focus

in_semester.name: Continuous Internal Evaluation (CIE)
in_semester.notes: NEP-aligned CIE: two IA tests (30% each) + assignments/quiz (40%). Practical subjects have separate CIE.

instructions: Answer any FIVE full questions, choosing at least ONE from each module.
Module 1: Q.1 or Q.2, Module 2: Q.3 or Q.4, Module 3: Q.5 or Q.6, Module 4: Q.7 or Q.8, Module 5: Q.9 or Q.10.
Neat diagrams must be drawn wherever necessary.
Figures to the right indicate full marks.

question_structure.description: Five modules each with an OR-pair. Each full question is 12 marks with sub-questions. Theory subjects may have 20-mark questions with 10+10 or 8+12 split.
